info.title: Gamo Studios HTTP API — local foundation
info.description: Authoritative contract for Gamo Studios, a Christian, mission-driven Public Benefit Corporation. Demo/incomplete operations are explicitly labeled. Internal operations must not be published. No production readiness or payment authorization implied.

license.name: Private repository; no public API license

get.description: Persisted participation inquiry workflow. Identity verification is required; participation submission does not approve eligibility.

post.summary: submit Participation
post.description: Persisted participation inquiry workflow. Identity verification is required; participation submission does not approve eligibility.
post.x-authorization: Verified account; only own records.
post.x-idempotency: Unsupported; client keys ignored.

post.summary: Create a local demo session
post.description: Email-only provisioning is NOT identity verification. Explicit local demo environment only; production returns 403. Credential or verified email challenge flow is available separately.
post.x-authorization: Public
post.x-idempotency: Unsupported; client keys are ignored.

delete.x-idempotency: Revocation is repeatable, including absent or invalid cookies.

post.summary: Issue an email verification challenge
post.description: Generates a time-bounded 6-digit verification code (hashed with SHA-256 in D1 auth_challenges) and dispatches it via email. Enforces per-email rate limiting.
post.x-authorization: Public (same-origin enforced)
post.x-idempotency: Rate-limited per email (maximum 5 challenges per 15 minutes).

post.summary: Verify email challenge code and establish authenticated session
post.description: Verifies the 6-digit challenge code against D1 auth_challenges, enforces expiry and attempt lockout, sets users.verified_email_at, revokes any presented prior session cookie, and issues a new host-only HttpOnly __session cookie.
post.x-authorization: Public (same-origin enforced; valid unconsumed challenge code required)
post.x-idempotency: Single-use challenge code; replay after consumption returns 401.

post.summary: Exchange a fresh Clerk session token for a Gamo session cookie
post.description: Only for a product with Clerk configured. Clerk session tokens last about a minute and are refreshed by Clerk's browser script, which ordinary pages do not load. After Clerk sign-in the browser sends the current token as a Bearer token; the token is verified against this product's own Clerk application (signature, issuer, authorized party), the product account is found or created, and a 7-day host-only HttpOnly __session cookie backed by a D1 session is issued. Tokens from another product's Clerk application are refused.
post.x-authorization: Public (same-origin enforced; valid Clerk session token for this product required in the Authorization header).
post.x-idempotency: Each call issues a new session and revokes the presented prior one.

get.summary: Inspect current authenticated user, roles, and organization memberships
get.description: Validates the active D1 session cookie and returns the authenticated user profile, global system roles, and active organization memberships.

post.summary: Onboard a church, ministry, academy partner, or sponsor organization
post.description: Requires an authenticated session with a verified email address. Creates the organization, assigns the caller as active owner in organization_members, initializes an unverified organizer_profiles record, and records an audit log entry.
post.x-authorization: Active D1 session with verified email required.
post.x-idempotency: Organization slug is globally unique; duplicate slug returns 409.

get.description: At most 50 results ordered by startsAt then id ascending. meta.total is returned row count, not all matching rows. No cursor or client limit yet. Unknown query fields are rejected.

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Performer or artist name substring filter.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Minimum event start date (ISO 8601 date or timestamp).

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Maximum event start date (ISO 8601 date or timestamp).

parameters.name: metro
parameters.description: Metro area slug filter (e.g., phoenix-az, atlanta-ga, nashville-tn).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search query matching event title, performers, venue, or city.

parameters.name: weekend
parameters.description: Filter events occurring on Friday evening, Saturday, or Sunday in their local timezone.

post.summary: Create an event (organizer)
post.description: Two request shapes. The organizer form (EventEditInput: venue-local start date and time in an IANA zone, policies within bounds, ticket categories) creates the event, its policies and categories in one batch: the organizer's first event goes to pending_review, later ones publish once an event of that organizer was approved (unless staff set always_review). The older shape (CreateEvent with startsAt) is still accepted and always goes to review.
post.x-authorization: Active owner/admin membership of organizationId, or superadmin. Session verification required; no demo header bypass.
post.x-idempotency: Unsupported; client keys are ignored.

400.description: Documented API failure. Internal details are suppressed.

401.description: Documented API failure. Internal details are suppressed.

403.description: Documented API failure. Internal details are suppressed.

500.description: Documented API failure. Internal details are suppressed.

patch.description: Edits details, policies and ticket categories (edit_content; categories also need manage_ticketing). Once tickets exist the date and venue change only through POST /api/events/{id}/changes so holders are told; capacity never goes below what is reserved; existing orders keep their policy snapshot and price.
patch.x-authorization: Verified session with edit_content and manage_ticketing permissions on the event.
patch.x-idempotency: Last write wins; the same body twice is harmless.

post.summary: Reserve free tickets (email verification required)
post.description: Free RSVP (design 4.2): Turnstile, per-IP and per-email limits, validation, one atomic hold batch, then an email with a 6-digit code and a confirm link. Tickets are issued only after the email is confirmed (POST /api/orders/confirm or the link). The answer is identical whether or not the address already has tickets. Sold out returns 409 with remaining counts per category.
post.x-authorization: Public (Turnstile and rate limits).
post.x-idempotency: idempotencyKey (rendered into the form) returns the same order.

202.description: Verification email sent (or the identical answer)

schema.description: The same fields from the server-rendered form (quantities as qty.<categoryId>[.<sectionId>]).

post.summary: Assign role-scoped event team member
post.description: Grants or updates granular per-event permissions. Content/publishing roles cannot grant refund approval or settlement access unless the actor is primary organization owner or superadmin.
post.x-authorization: Verified session with event owner/admin or edit_content permission.
post.x-idempotency: Upserts on (eventId, userId, role).

delete.summary: Revoke a role-scoped event team member
delete.description: Sets the member's role on this event to revoked and writes an audit row. Only an organization owner or admin (or superadmin) can revoke; granting ticketing, scanning or production access is limited to the same people.
delete.x-authorization: Verified session with edit_content on the event, and organization owner or admin to revoke.
delete.x-idempotency: Revoking an already revoked member changes nothing.

get.summary: List production requests linked to an event
get.description: Returns permission-scoped production service records for the event without exposing financial settlements or attendee personal data.
get.x-authorization: Verified session with coordinate_production or edit_content permission on the event.

post.summary: Request Gamo Production support for an event
post.description: Creates a linked Gamo Production request directly from the event context without duplicating event identity or requiring unrelated logins.
post.x-authorization: Verified session with coordinate_production permission on the event.
post.x-idempotency: Creates linked production request.

post.summary: Email a link to my tickets
post.description: Always answers the same. When the address has tickets it receives a customer:all link (30 minutes) that opens the same tickets; recovery never issues new ones. Every lookup that finds an order is logged in ticket_access_log.
post.x-authorization: Public (Turnstile and rate limits).
post.x-idempotency: Not needed; repeated requests are rate limited.

schema.description: The same fields from the server-rendered form (quantities as qty.<categoryId>[.<sectionId>]).

post.summary: Validate and check in QR admission pass
post.description: Verifies tamper-resistant QR ticket or registration pass, prevents replay admission, and records scan audit trail.
post.x-authorization: Verified session with scan_tickets permission on eventId.
post.x-idempotency: Rejects duplicate scan with 409 REPLAY_BLOCKED.

get.description: Lists verified artist profiles for concert and event discovery.

post.summary: Create or onboard artist profile
post.description: Creates a live performance artist profile for the authenticated user without coupling Gamo Worship rankings.
post.x-authorization: Verified user session.
post.x-idempotency: One artist profile per user/slug.

post.summary: Authorize booking agent or manager for an artist
post.description: Records scoped representation authorization with conflict detection for exclusive representation.
post.x-authorization: Verified artist owner or superadmin.
post.x-idempotency: Rejects conflicting exclusive representation with 409.

post.summary: Revoke artist representation authorization
post.description: Revokes an active representation authorization, blocking future booking/negotiation/financial access while preserving existing confirmed engagements and audit history.
post.x-authorization: Verified artist owner, representative owner, or superadmin.
post.x-idempotency: Idempotent revocation.

post.summary: Send artist booking inquiry
post.description: Verified organizer sends a booking inquiry and initial proposed terms to an artist or authorized representative.
post.x-authorization: Verified session with organization owner/admin or event negotiate_booking permission.
post.x-idempotency: Creates distinct inquiry record.

post.summary: Submit booking offer or counteroffer
post.description: Authorized organizer, artist, or active representative submits a booking offer or counteroffer with separate artist fee, agent commission, and platform allocation line items.
post.x-authorization: Verified organizer negotiator, artist (when allowSelfBooking), or active unrevoked representative with negotiation scope.
post.x-idempotency: Appends immutable offer revision.

post.summary: Confirm booking offer and create engagement
post.description: Authorized counterparty accepts a proposed offer, locking terms as immutable and creating a confirmed performance engagement with deposits disabled pending policy approval.
post.x-authorization: Authorized counterparty (artist/representative for organizer offers, or organizer negotiator for artist/representative counteroffers).
post.x-idempotency: Rejects duplicate acceptance with 409.

post.summary: Refund (paid) or cancel (free) chosen tickets
post.description: Requires approve_refunds on the event. Only the chosen tickets (all valid ones when none are given) change; refunds accumulate and never exceed the total; card refunds go through Stripe test mode.
post.x-authorization: Verified session with approve_refunds permission on the event.
post.x-idempotency: Repeating a refund of the same tickets changes nothing; Stripe key refund_<recordId>.

post.summary: Start paid checkout (Stripe test mode)
post.description: Same order form as free RSVPs. 503 unless ENVIRONMENT is local or preview, STRIPE_TEST_CHECKOUT is true and a test key is set (production is always 503, in code); local without a key uses the local mock page. Holds the tickets in one batch and creates a Checkout Session whose expires_at covers the hold. An order whose total is 0 takes the free flow (202).
post.x-authorization: Public (Turnstile and rate limits).
post.x-idempotency: idempotencyKey returns the same order; Stripe key checkout_<orderId>.

schema.description: The same fields from the server-rendered form (quantities as qty.<categoryId>[.<sectionId>]).

post.summary: Receive a signed Stripe test event
post.description: Signature and test mode verified. Claims the event id (409 while another delivery is processing) and dispatches checkout.session.completed and async_payment_succeeded (issue tickets once; amount, currency and payment status checked; paid after the stock is gone becomes paid_unfulfillable with an automatic test refund), checkout.session.expired, charge.refunded, refund.updated and charge.dispute.created; other types are recorded as ignored. Failures answer 500 so Stripe retries; 503 without STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
post.x-authorization: Public (Stripe signature).
post.x-idempotency: Stripe event id claimed in D1; per-seat issuance is idempotent.

post.summary: Receive a Svix-signed event from this product's own Clerk application
post.description: Verified with CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET_<APP> (Svix scheme, 5-minute timestamp tolerance). session.ended, session.revoked and session.removed revoke the D1 sessions exchanged from that Clerk session id in this product; user.deleted and user.banned revoke every D1 session of the linked user in this product, and user.deleted also suspends the Clerk identity link. Other events are ignored with 200. Answers 503 when the secret is not configured.
post.x-authorization: Svix signature with this product's Clerk webhook secret.
post.x-idempotency: Revocations are conditional; replays change nothing.

post.summary: Unlink (or link again) this product's account from the shared person record
post.description: Plain HTML form post (no JavaScript needed). unlink clears users.person_id and writes a person.unlinked audit row, which also stops automatic re-linking at the next sign-in; link re-attaches the account to the person of its verified email. Never grants access in another product. Redirects 303 to /account with person=unlinked|linked|unchanged or error=<code>.
post.x-authorization: Verified session with an active account in this product; same origin.
post.x-idempotency: Repeating the same action leaves the link unchanged.

303.description: Form handled; redirects back to the page with the outcome in the query string.

post.summary: Provider onboarding steps, terms, submit for review and publish
post.description: Plain HTML form post used by /account/onboarding and /account/profile. start creates the draft profile for one of this product's sign-up roles; save stores one onboarding step as a draft (invalid fields are listed in the redirect); terms records the current Provider (or Organizer) Terms; submit sends the profile to staff review (verified email, complete profile and current terms required); publish lists it when every publish gate holds (staff verification for church, musician, technician and teacher; payout setup is not available yet and never blocks a profile); unpublish takes it off public view. Redirects 303 to the page with the outcome in the query string.
post.x-authorization: Verified session with an active account in this product; same origin; the profile must belong to the signed-in person.
post.x-idempotency: start and submit are idempotent; save overwrites the same step; publish is conditional on the status read.

303.description: Form handled; redirects back to the page with the outcome in the query string.

post.summary: Scan a ticket in or out at the door
post.description: Verifies a GL1 code (or a legacy gamt_ pass) and lets the database decide admission (one conditional presence upsert). Results expose first name and last initial, category, section and zone only. Rate-limited per device.
post.x-authorization: Scanner device cookie for this event, or a verified Gamo Live session with scan_tickets on eventId. Same-origin required for POST.
post.x-idempotency: clientScanId is recorded once per scanner session; a repeat answers the stored result with repeated=true.

post.summary: Manual ticket lookup (dead phone, name check)
post.description: Finds up to 10 tickets of the event by order reference, email (exact) or name. Organizer accounts and supervisor scanner sessions (can_override) only. Every result is written to ticket_access_log.
post.x-authorization: Supervisor scanner device for this event or a verified Gamo Live session with scan_tickets on eventId.
post.x-idempotency: Read-only (each call is logged).

post.summary: Admit a ticket without its code, with a reason
post.description: Supervisor override: lifts the entry limit but never admits someone already inside; zones and the scan window still apply. Recorded as override_admitted with the reason and in ticket_access_log.
post.x-authorization: Supervisor scanner device for this event or a verified Gamo Live session with scan_tickets on eventId.
post.x-idempotency: clientScanId is recorded once per scanner session.

get.summary: Offline manifest for a scanner device
get.description: Event-scoped list of ticket id parts, versions, MAC digests, category, section, zone, status, presence and holder initials, for offline verification. No emails, full names or order data. Supports If-None-Match.
get.x-authorization: Scanner device cookie for this event, or a verified Gamo Live session with scan_tickets on eventId.
get.x-idempotency: Safe; ETag reflects the content (304 when unchanged).

304.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched the current ETag).

post.summary: Replay a device’s offline scan queue
post.description: Replays up to 200 queued scans in device-time order through the same statements as online scanning. Scans that lost to an earlier admission are flagged duplicate_offline and counted in needsReview. Scanner devices only.
post.x-authorization: Scanner device cookie for this event. Same-origin required.
post.x-idempotency: Each clientScanId is recorded once; a retried sync records nothing new.

get.summary: Live headcount for the scanner screen
get.description: People inside now, admitted today (venue-local day) and capacity. Polled every 10 seconds while online.
get.x-authorization: Scanner device cookie for this event, or a verified Gamo Live session with scan_tickets on eventId.

get.description: Serves an uploaded blueprint (PNG, JPEG, WebP or sanitised SVG) as an image with X-Content-Type-Options nosniff and Content-Security-Policy sandbox; never inlined into pages. Archived blueprints are not served. Cacheable by content hash (the v query parameter).
get.x-authorization: Public (blueprint ids are random; only non-archived blueprints are served).

post.summary: Confirm a free order with the emailed code
post.description: Issues the tickets (one per seat, signed QR) and opens a customer session for the order. Five wrong codes per order per 30 minutes; a token for an order that does not exist behaves like a wrong code.
post.x-authorization: Public (code from the email).
post.x-idempotency: Confirming twice issues nothing new.

post.summary: Transfer a ticket to another person
post.description: The current holder only (customer session), within the order's policy snapshot. Bumps the version so every old QR stops working. Of two concurrent transfers of one ticket exactly one succeeds (409 for the other).
post.x-authorization: Customer session holding the ticket.
post.x-idempotency: Conditional on the ticket version the holder saw.

post.summary: Reissue a ticket with a new code
post.description: Organizer with manage_ticketing on the event (or staff). A reason is required; the old QR dies and the holder is emailed the new ticket.
post.x-authorization: Verified session with manage_ticketing permission.
post.x-idempotency: Conditional on the current version.

post.summary: Cancel, reschedule or move an event
post.description: cancelled (manage_ticketing and approve_refunds) voids every ticket, refunds paid orders in full (test mode) and emails everyone. rescheduled and venue_changed (edit_content) keep tickets valid and email everyone an updated .ics (same UID, higher SEQUENCE).
post.x-authorization: Verified session with the permissions above.
post.x-idempotency: Notifications are keyed per change, order and address.

post.summary: Join the waitlist of a sold-out event
post.description: Same answer whether or not the address was already waiting. When tickets are released the earliest entries are emailed; nothing is reserved or charged.
post.x-authorization: Public (Turnstile and rate limits).
post.x-idempotency: One entry per event, category and address.

schema.description: The same fields from the server-rendered form (quantities as qty.<categoryId>[.<sectionId>]).

post.summary: Receive a signed Resend event
post.description: Svix signature with RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET (503 without it). Updates the email_log status; hard bounces and complaints add the address hash to email_suppressions.
post.x-authorization: Public (Svix signature).
post.x-idempotency: Statuses never move backwards; repeated events change nothing.

Identifier.description: Opaque case-sensitive resource identifier; never parse for authority.

next.description: Same-site path to continue at (provider onboarding after a sign-up with a role).

role.description: Provider role chosen on the sign-up screen (sign-up only; must be one of this product's sign-up roles, otherwise ignored).

cf-turnstile-response.description: Cloudflare Turnstile token (required outside ENVIRONMENT=local; local accepts the documented dummy token).

role.description: Provider role chosen on the sign-up screen (sign-up only; must be one of this product's sign-up roles, otherwise ignored).

terms.description: Sign-up only — the terms documents the form showed (current Site Terms and Privacy Policy versions are required).

marketingOptIn.description: Sign-up only — the separate, never pre-ticked marketing checkbox.

ClerkSessionInput.description: Optional body of the Clerk token exchange; carries what the sign-up screen collected.

role.description: Provider role chosen on the sign-up screen (sign-up only; must be one of this product's sign-up roles, otherwise ignored).

ClerkWebhookEvent.description: Clerk webhook payload (only type and data.id are read).

ProviderAccountForm.description: Onboarding form fields. Besides the listed controls, a save carries the step's own fields (role-specific, validated server-side by the step schema) as plain strings.

meeting_at.description: Local date and time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM) in meeting_zone.

meeting_zone.description: IANA time zone of meeting_at (default America/Phoenix).

code.description: Scanned or typed ticket code (GL1 payload, or a legacy gamt_ pass).

query.description: Holder or purchaser name (contains), email (exact) or order reference (exact).

ScannerManifestResponse.description: Event-scoped offline manifest. No emails, no full names, no order data.

eventDayKey.description: Presence key of tickets without validDays (one per event); multi-day passes use the local date after shifting the clock back 5 hours.

d.description: SHA-256 hex of the current QR MAC.

TicketingError.description: Ticketing failure. `message` always says what to do next. `details` is a list of field errors (public form guard) or an object with field errors, remaining counts (409 SOLD_OUT) and a wait time (429).

OrderInput.description: One form for free RSVPs and paid checkout. The JSON form of the server-rendered order form (which posts the same fields form-encoded as qty.<categoryId>[.<sectionId>]).

TicketCheckoutInput.description: One form for free RSVPs and paid checkout. The JSON form of the server-rendered order form (which posts the same fields form-encoded as qty.<categoryId>[.<sectionId>]).

data.description: Same answer whether or not the address already has tickets.

confirmToken.description: Signed reference for the code page (/tickets/confirm?t=…). Not a credential.

checkoutUrl.description: Stripe Checkout (test mode) or, in local development only, the local mock page.

CategoryInput.description: A ticket category ("ticket type"). Price in dollars as typed or integer cents.

LocalDateTime.description: Venue-local date and time (converted with the event's IANA time zone, DST-safe).

EventPolicyInput.description: Event policies within the platform bounds (design §5.4). Missing fields take the defaults.

EventCreateRequest.description: Either the organizer form (EventEditInput with organizationId) or the older CreateEvent shape.

EventEditInput.description: Organizer event create/edit with venue-local date/time, policies and categories.

movedToReview.description: True when a change to public details sent the event back to staff review.

StripeWebhookResponse.description: Outcome of one Stripe event (`outcome` names what happened; extra fields per type).

ClientScanId.description: Device-generated id; the same id twice from one scanner session is recorded once.

ScanResult.description: Outcome of one scan (design §5.3). Shown with icon, colour and text on the scanner. event_ended (scanning closed 6 h after the event end) is answered but not stored.

ScanTicketView.description: What a scanner may see about a ticket. Never an email, full name or order data.

holder.description: First name and last initial only.

repeated.description: This client scan id had already been recorded; the stored result is returned.

BrowserSession.name: __session
BrowserSession.description: HMAC signed session ID verified against D1. Not proof of identity at session issuance.

CloudflareAccess.name: Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion
CloudflareAccess.description: RS256 JWT verified against configured audience, issuer and JWKS. Staff application boundary, not domain RBAC.

StripeSignature.name: Stripe-Signature
StripeSignature.description: HMAC SHA256 over timestamp and exact raw request body. Replay tolerance enforced. Test events only.

ScannerDevice.name: gamo_scanner
ScannerDevice.description: Door-staff scanner device cookie (HMAC-signed device id, purpose scanner_device, at most 12 hours and never past the gate session's expiry). Issued after the gate PIN; path-scoped to /scan and /api/scanner. Not an account.

CustomerSession.name: __gamo_customer_live
CustomerSession.description: Signed customer session opened from an emailed link (scoped to the customer, an order or a ticket; at most 2 hours). Customers have no account.

LegacyError.description: Documented API failure. Internal details are suppressed.

TicketingError.description: Ticketing failure; the message says what to do next. Internal details are suppressed.

id.name: id
id.description: Event identifier; public detail additionally accepts a slug.

schema.description: Opaque case-sensitive resource identifier; never parse for authority.
